question: Sirius and Fortuna both love a person without an actual body; what would Capella do when she met someone like that. ‘Someone who can’t love me is a nuisance’ sort of a thing?
answer: Those two don’t really have a ‘person without an actual body’ fetish. Also, Capella’s assertion is that no matter who someone happens to love, if she transforms into a person’s favorite form, they’ll always love her. “Saying you love what’s on the inside is all just words, what you love is what you see here”, like that. She only becomes hostile when she meets someone who won’t fall in love with her, and then she’ll change them into bugs or something. Changing the people at City Hall into flies was her sort of an expression of love.
